stem: Based on the excerpt, which statement describes the inventions of George Washington Carver?

options.label: A
options.text: They diversified the uses for agricultural products.

options.label: B
options.text: They expanded research efforts to prevent diseases.

options.label: C
options.text: They led to improvements in weapons technology.

options.label: D
options.text: They identified needed changes to dietary guidelines.

visual_elements: Professor [George Washington] Carver has made almost everything from the [common] peanut except dynamite. And those who have seen him at work and know the wonders he has performed would not be surprised if he did that in a pinch. By the way, he helped win . . . World War [I], not by manufacturing explosives to destroy the lives of human beings, but by converting sweet potatoes into flour, so as to provide food for them and save them.
